summary_md:
# 89. Fyra småbolag för den riskvillige

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-09-29  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Veckans Trade episode 89: the host interviews student and private investor Devin Gavgani, who pitches small caps for risk-tolerant investors. Before the pitches they discuss the sell-off in property stocks on high rates and pref-share placements, a skeptical view of the recent wave of IPOs (seen as roll-ups with poor liquidity), and a dip in iGaming stocks over Brazilian election risk. The pitches are Bulten (strong buy thesis), Qliro (buy on the turnaround to profit) and Dedicare (watch). A fourth case, Combined X, is only introduced before the transcript ends. The market tone is mixed: bearish on property and IPOs, contrarian and bullish on neglected turnaround small caps.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 BULTEN — Bulten | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Divestment of manufacturing arm, easy comps vs JLR hack, ~6x EBIT, new LAM Research contract, insider buying and CEO options struck at double the share price.

#### Reasoning

Guest pitch, and the host says he is also bullish. The remaining business is a more asset-light C-parts distributor with ~8% pro forma EBIT margin and less debt. The next two quarters have easy comps as JLR volumes (~280m lost) recover. It trades at ~6x EBIT vs Bufab >25x. Upside comes from a higher multiple, new contracts in semiconductors, medtech and data centres, acquisitions and margin expansion. Insiders bought ~18m SEK of shares.

#### Sell Triggers

- if JLR suffers another production stoppage
- if the 8% EBIT margin run-rate is not sustained
- if the shift away from the auto industry stalls

> *"Jag blir faktiskt också bull Bulten om man får säga så."*

---

### 🟢 QLIRO — Qliro | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Just turned profitable, ~85% fixed costs so highly scalable, growing TPV and SME merchants; Walley peer has 15-17% margins; cheap a few years out.

#### Reasoning

Guest thesis: a 100% revenue increase lifts costs only ~30%, so profits should accelerate from a low base. Its checkout converts better than Kustom's in A/B tests. Risks: capital requirements force share issues (dilution), no insider buying, a tiny profit so far. The host prefers Bulten but will follow Qliro.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further dilutive share issues are needed
- if profitability reverses
- if merchant/TPV growth stalls

> *"så är det väldigt billigt om man tittar några år ut."*

---

### 🟠 DEDI — Dedicare | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Swedish hired-staff share at a 10-year low, Sweden grew 22% in Q2, cheap acquisitions (~6x EBIT) in less cyclical care. Guest doesn't own it; waiting for more quarters.

#### Reasoning

A possible cyclical bottom in healthcare staffing, with Norway at 60% of sales. Acquisitions in psychiatry and care homes add higher margins and stability. Asset-light and cash generative, could reach ~6x EV/EBIT in a year. Ambea/Attendo re-rating analogy. Only one quarter of turnaround, so the guest is watching closely.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Swedish growth reverses
- if political bans on hired healthcare staff advance
- if Norway weakens further

> *"det här inte är någonting jag äger eftersom det bara varit ett kvartal av 'vändning'. Men det är någonting jag kikar väldigt nära på."*

---

### 🟢 EAST — Eastnine | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest owns it; host bought some on instinct amid the property sell-off, arguing that good property companies should be at buying levels.

#### Reasoning

Contrarian bet during the property sell-off: not all property companies can be bad. Risk from the leveraged Warsaw acquisition and high rates.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates stay elevated long-term
- if refinancing terms on the Warsaw acquisition hurt earnings

> *"Men jag gillar Eastnine. Jag har också köpläge."*

---

### 🟢 BALD-B — Balder | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host thinks you won't lose money buying Balder in the sell-off, depending on your risk appetite.

#### Reasoning

Speculative contrarian view by the host during the rate-driven property sell-off.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the 10-year yield keeps rising
- if property fund outflows continue

> *"Men jag tror inte man förlorar pengar på att köpa Balder heller."*

---
